Nigard Glacier, Norway

Nigard Glacier’s easy access makes it possible to get close to its striking blue ice. Guided glacier walks are available to visitors aged five and older.

To reach the glacier, drive through Jostedalen Valley to Breheimsenteret, a national park center known for its glacier-inspired architecture. From there, continue to the parking area, then walk beside the lake or take a boat across.

At nearly 1,000 feet above sea level, the glacier creates an alpine setting alongside the lake and glacier tongue. The nearby river delta also offers a glimpse of how landscapes are shaped.

Beyond its scenic appeal, the glacier’s meltwater helps generate hydro-electric power in Norway, while the landscape has inspired major works of Norwegian national-romantic art.
